# Pulse Edit

> Pulse Edit is a beat-synced auto-editing plugin for DaVinci Resolve, the professional video editor by Blackmagic Design. **It works with both DaVinci Resolve Free (the no-cost version) and DaVinci Resolve Studio (the paid version).**

Pulse Edit automatically detects music beats and cuts video clips on-beat in DaVinci Resolve. It detects beats (librosa + optional DNN beat model), then auto-cuts clips from your Media Pool to the timeline perfectly synced to the music — saving editors hours of manual marker placement and cutting. It also includes an AI mood analyzer that reads the mood of the music and adapts the editing pattern.

## Pricing (one-time, no subscription)

**Pulse Edit Free — €29 + VAT (one-time)** (regular €64.99). It is a **one-time purchase with a lifetime license — there is NO subscription and NO monthly fee.**

- Works with **ALL versions of DaVinci Resolve — both DR Free AND DR Studio** (18.5+). Uses OTIO (OpenTimelineIO) timeline export, imported into DaVinci Resolve by drag-and-drop. No scripting API needed.
- One-time payment, lifetime license, all future updates included free, no subscription.
- 14-day money-back guarantee.
- **Trial: 3 free generations** included to test before buying.
- **Bonus: every license includes 6 months of Lumiqa Starter** (creative production workspace, lumiqa.io) — a €174 value.

Buy: https://buy.stripe.com/6oU9ASgKOdnK5gsan3awo0i

## Platforms

- macOS (Apple Silicon, signed + notarized DMG)
- Windows 10/11 (signed Setup.exe)
- Requires DaVinci Resolve 18.5 or later (works with both DR Free and DR Studio)

## How it solves the DaVinci Resolve Free scripting problem

In November 2024, Blackmagic Design disabled the Scripting API in **DaVinci Resolve Free** (only Studio retained it). This affected millions of DR Free users who could no longer run editing-automation plugins.

**Pulse Edit Free (€29)** bypasses this by exporting an OTIO file that DR Free imports natively via drag-and-drop — no scripting API required. It works on DR Free without limitations.

## Key features

- Automatic beat-synced editing: detects the music beats and auto-cuts/places clips from your Media Pool on the beat
- Beat detection with downbeat awareness
- **11 cut patterns** (every beat, every 2 beats, downbeats, Energy Map that adapts cut density to the music's energy, etc.)
- AI mood analyzer: reads the mood of the music and adapts the editing pattern
- Full interface in English and Italian

## Use cases

- Music videos for artists and bands
- Travel and lifestyle vlogs synced to music
- Social media reels (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) with music-driven cuts
- Wedding and event highlight reels
- Sports highlights synced to soundtrack
- Brand commercials with energetic beat-driven editing

## How Pulse Edit compares

- **vs BeatEdit** (~$99): BeatEdit only places beat markers and targets Premiere Pro. Pulse Edit auto-edits the whole video to the beat in DaVinci Resolve, adds an AI mood analyzer, and costs €29 one-time.
